title: Control Media Buy Response
description: Body of a completed control_media_buy: the applied operational controls, without the package or creative object graphs. The submitted, working and input-required bodies are control-media-buy-async-response-*.json, and the failed body is control-media-buy-failed.json. The schema build generates the wire response, control-media-buy-wire-response.json, from these status bodies.

warnings.description: Non-blocking observations about this completed control. The control was still applied exactly as represented. Continuing conditions also appear as indicators on get_media_buys.
